content.short: AIOZ Network is a DePIN providing Web3 services for AI computing, decentralized storage, and media streaming.
content.description: AIOZ Network is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) providing a comprehensive suite of Web3 services, including AI computing, storage, and media streaming. Its AI marketplace allows developers to rent GPU/CPU power, while AIOZ Storage offers an S3-compatible decentralized solution, all powered by a global network of edge nodes. The platform also features AIOZ Stream, a peer-to-peer video delivery protocol for low-cost, high-quality streaming. By utilizing a decentralized content delivery network, AIOZ improves delivery speeds compared to traditional cloud providers globally.
